feeds.title: Streets Dept
feeds.description: StreetsDept.com is a photo-blog that discovers art on the streets of Philadelphia. The primary focus of Streets Dept is documenting and celebrating street art and muralism across Philly's public spaces. Conrad Benner is the Founder of StreetsDept.com. His work explores art, our public space, and the creative minds shaping the world around us.

feeds.title: The Philadelphia Office of Arts, Culture and the Creative Economy
feeds.description: Get to know the latest news from the Philadelphia Office of Arts, Culture and the Creative Economy. The OACCE closes the gap in access to the arts for all Philadelphians and is committed to equitable support of culture and creativity throughout the city's neighborhoods.

feeds.title: Artblog
feeds.description: The Artblog is an ongoing conversation about Art and Community in Philadelphia and the World. Our mission is to create and foster dialog about art, power, value and truth, in order to promote a better future for all. Our independent online arts publication focuses on marginalized artists, BIPOC, LGBTQ artists and women, whose art traditionally has been shunned by the mainstream media.

feeds.title: Philadelphia Museum of Art Newsroom
feeds.description: Welcome to the Philadelphia Museum of Art pressroom - your media resource page. Read about the latest exhibitions in the Philadelphia Museum of Art. For nearly 150 years, the museum has reflected the unique passions of Philadelphia collectors and curators. The Philadelphia Museum of Art is one of the country's oldest art museums and has long been recognized as one of its finest.

feeds.title: October Gallery
feeds.description: Enjoy October Gallery's art feed showcasing exquisite, evocative, and culturally significant art. Read artist profiles and links to where you can buy their art. October Gallery is an art gallery in Philadelphia that focuses on curation of African American Art, Black Art, Poetry, Health, Travel, and more.

feeds.title: POSITIVE PUBLICITY » Philadelphia Art
feeds.description: Welcome, I am Camille and this is Positive Publicity! This blog aims to bring together a little bit of everything we love in life - from music, to style, traveling and dining. Here, I share personal stories, travel experiences, band interviews, conversations with awesome people, and much more. I work as the the Director of PR and Marketing at a non-profit arts organization.

feeds.title: Paula Cahill Blog
feeds.description: Paula Cahill is a contemporary abstract painter who lives in the NYC / Philadelphia region. Her paintings feature line and colors derived from her memories of scuba diving on coral reefs. Visit the blog to get her latest news.

feeds.description: Philadelphia Weekly gives you the most recent updates related to Arts within the city. Philadelphia Weekly is the city's leading alternative news source, with unique, sharp-edged coverage of current affairs, city life and culture.
